answer: Whisper Crystal Pricing Each agent must submit a unique cryptographic whisper—a low-bandwidth, time-bound commitment—to a distributed trellis structure every 10 seconds. The trellis verifies consistency across whispers from the same IP and device fingerprint within a 3-second window. To coordinate multiple identities, an attacker must generate distinct whispers from separate hardware profiles, each requiring a full TLS handshake and dedicated ephemeral key pair. Each such whisper incurs a fixed 0.001 ETH fee, paid upfront and non-refundable.
